blocks.title: ADB Device Admin / Kiosk
blocks.body:
# ADB Commands for Device Admin (Kiosk)

## Quick visual

![Device owner / kiosk flow](/media/diagrams/device-owner-flow.svg)

Device owner can only be set on a clean (unprovisioned) device. Plan for factory reset if you need to remove ownership.

Managing devices with `com.milinav/.kiosk.MyDeviceAdminReceiver`.

## Prerequisites
- Developer Options and USB Debugging enabled.
- Unlock Developer Options by tapping Build Number 7 times.
- Device connected via USB.

## Commands

### Check connected devices
```
adb devices
```

### Reboot
```
adb reboot
adb reboot recovery
adb reboot bootloader
```

### Factory reset
```
adb shell am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MASTER_CLEAR
```
Caution: erases all user data.

### Set device owner (after factory reset)
```
adb shell dpm set-device-owner com.milinav/.kiosk.MyDeviceAdminReceiver
```
Only works on a freshly reset device.

### Remove device admin
```
adb shell dpm remove-active-admin com.milinav/.kiosk.MyDeviceAdminReceiver
```
Force for user 0:
```
adb shell dpm remove-active-admin --user 0 com.milinav/.kiosk.MyDeviceAdminReceiver
```

## Notes
- Setting device owner requires a factory-reset device with no accounts.
- Removing admin may require a factory reset if policies are strict.
